conclusion: This fixed H3 configuration substantially damages the single identity and near-clean source relative to both input and R_phi-only. Alpha0.25 anchoring mitigates but does not remove the harm. Complete execution is not quality acceptance; do not automatically expand ordinary development evaluation.

identity_duplicate_evidence.limitations: Recorded output hashes and scalar equality checked; NPZ arrays were intentionally excluded from this small archive and were not independently rehashed.

clipping_interpretation.interpretation: The R_phi guide is clipped before H3. Post-anchor clipping is zero for native tasks and about0.45-0.54% for SR, increasing the recorded Q4 residual only slightly. Native harm persists with zero post-anchor clipping, so it cannot be attributed to this final clamp alone. Raw-versus-clipped generated quality and raw R_phi quality were not separately scored here, so no complete clamp ablation is claimed.

ordinary_compression_connection.interpretation: Ordinary compression already showed H3 damage on an almost-clean observation. Reference-derived identity and sigma1 near-clean controls now show the same direction without a compression operator, making failure to preserve good input a concrete hypothesis. This does not isolate whether VAE reconstruction, the chosen high-noise sampling recipe, conditioning, or runtime parity is responsible; it also remains one shared source.

timing.interpretation: Component timings only; not end-to-end latency or streaming throughput. Full22 H3 block still uses future frames.

findings.finding: Input MAE/MSE/LPIPS/flow are exactly zero. R_phi-only introduces a small error; every H3 arm increases all four error measures relative to both input and R_phi-only. Do not interpret subtraction from capped identity PSNR120 as a meaningful dB degradation.
R_phi-only improves PSNR/MAE/MSE/LPIPS/flow for all four noise draws. All four H3 arms worsen all these metrics versus input and R_phi-only for all four draws.
For identity, changing the fixed-draft H3 guide from raw to R_phi worsens PSNR/MAE/MSE/LPIPS/flow; near-clean gains from guide choice do not overcome the large damage relative to baselines.
Alpha0.25 soft anchor improves H3 outputs but leaves substantial damage. Both anchors use R_phi RGB; neither is a guaranteed physical measurement projection or an abstention mechanism.

Paired guide comparison uses identical seed, raw/control-input encoded draft, steps, schedule, pretrained model and float metrics. Identity copies reproduce recorded output hashes exactly; this supports engineering repeatability but adds no independent-source evidence.

recommended_low_cost_diagnostics.name: saved_output_residual_magnitude_curve
recommended_low_cost_diagnostics.proposal: On existing decoded NPZs and stored guides, evaluate predefined scalar blends beta in[0,.05,.1,.25,.5,1] from input and separately from R_phi-only toward each H3 candidate; include beta0 baselines. Report RGB/LPIPS/adjacent-flow changes and residual magnitude separately for identity, near-clean and ordinary tasks.
recommended_low_cost_diagnostics.purpose: Determine whether any observed gain survives matched correction magnitude, and quantify how much H3 residual must be suppressed to preserve good inputs.
recommended_low_cost_diagnostics.limit: Exploratory development diagnostic only; no chosen beta may be reported as independently calibrated or novel selective-risk control.

recommended_low_cost_diagnostics.name: vae_roundtrip_localization
recommended_low_cost_diagnostics.proposal: Compute D(E(input)) and D(E(R_phi)) for the same one-source controls and ordinary clips using the frozen VAE, then score against target and existing generated outputs.
recommended_low_cost_diagnostics.purpose: Separate the VAE reconstruction floor from additional sampling damage before expanding model or dataset budgets.
recommended_low_cost_diagnostics.limit: Needs an isolated authorized VAE run; this review has not executed it.

recommended_low_cost_diagnostics.name: official_recipe_parity_audit
recommended_low_cost_diagnostics.proposal: Read-check official refiner-turbo guidance, warm-start/noise schedule and latent/image normalization against this frozen ComfyUI path; use the controls to decide a narrowly scoped follow-up if a discrepancy is found.
recommended_low_cost_diagnostics.purpose: Upstream parity is explicitly unvalidated; do not assume the observed damage is a property of all pretrained H3 usage.

next_step_policy: Prioritize failure localization and saved-output CPU diagnostics. Do not automatically launch full ordinary dev or add LoRA/confidence gating to conceal the single-source harm; multi-source validation follows a concrete fixed diagnostic hypothesis. No job or policy change is performed by this review.
